boundary.resolution: Installed reset/supervisor controller, three timing words, six raw fault words and two diagnostic ports; CPU privilege and shared device memory remain separate.

registers.resolution: All thirteen word ports with address/access/reset, CONTROL bit execution order and STATUS flags, raw fault/domain/cause/reason meanings and diagnostic operands.

datapath.resolution: Current CPU-mode gate, staged supervisor entry/leave, selected banks versus shared memory, integer TIME and derived PCRTC period/budget, UTF8 partial/completed output.

visibility.resolution: Accepted CONTROL handling versus self-clear/request consumption, ENTER/FAULT/PUBLISH/LEAVE edges, independent reads and output flush/publication/history/drawing distinctions.

timing.resolution: Installed system cycle basis, TIME truncation/wrap, raw Q16 period width, fractional next-period cycle budget and stopped beam; variable quiescence conditions not invented fixed latency.

interrupts.resolution: Independent VBlank-sampled rising request wire, NMI versus maskable IRQ acceptance, banked IRQ latches and ordinary owned VBlank predicate wait.

faults.resolution: Raw captured cause/EPC/domain and retained BadAddress/LuaReason, delayed publication, common mapped access faults and CONT retry rather than repair. RDB01 entry now parks completed unread USER readback and queued ingress rather than waiting for CPU consumption; transient supervisor scratch is torn down explicitly on LEAVE.

reset.resolution: System-wide reset request consumed at execution boundaries, no all-RAM-clearing promise, local/reset port words and diagnostic queue clearing distinct from ACK and flush.

programming.resolution: Compact control, time and diagnostic-output sequences accompany the supervisor transition, state preservation and raw fault reference.
